actions.action: Preserve product focus; give removals a predictable destination.
actions.mechanism: Stable product identities preserve focus through reordering; a persistent results heading receives focus when the focused product disappears.
actions.implementation: Reuse nodes keyed by product ID. Preserve the focused control. On removal, focus the results heading with tabindex="-1"; otherwise leave filter focus untouched.
actions.check: Reorder a retained focused product: its control stays focused. Remove it: focus reaches the heading. Filtering from a filter keeps focus there.
actions.risk: Replacing keyed nodes can still discard focus.

actions.action: Separate loading, result count, and empty states.
actions.mechanism: A persistent visible status and polite live region distinguish pending updates from completed searches, including zero matches.
actions.implementation: Show “Updating results” while pending. Commit only the latest request. Within one second of arrival, display its count and update the live region.
actions.check: Test delayed, zero-result, and out-of-order responses. Verify count timing, distinct loading text, and screen-reader announcements without focus movement.
actions.risk: Rapid announcements may queue; announce only current results.

actions.action: Offer a compact view without dropping matching products.
actions.mechanism: A keyboard-operated view toggle reduces card detail while retaining every matching product and access to full information.
actions.implementation: Keep count and view controls above results. Compact mode retains product names, distinguishing variants, prices, and detail links; preserve product order and control identities.
actions.check: With 200 matches, verify all 200 remain reachable in both modes. Toggle by keyboard; confirm focus stays on the toggle and variants remain distinguishable.
actions.risk: Removing distinguishing details can make products appear identical.
